schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs, the cover totals and the section-level language deduction; 4–7 listening transcript (never shown to students; PDF 7 opens with the end of Píosa 2); 7–11 listening answers, ending in the cover-mark table; 12–15 composition marking, Stíl/Ábhar bands, Cumas Gaeilge criteria (with the off-title pro-rata note) and the 80-mark table; 31 modified marking (SMM). PDF 16–30 are Paper 2; 32 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt, scheme slice and composition line is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

audio.note: The SEC archive serves one 2017 listening recording (LC001ZLP017IV.mp3, HTTP 200 on 2026-11-04, 5,288,546 bytes: a lower-bitrate file than 2018's), the same file name the archive uses for the shared Higher and Ordinary test in 2018–2025. The 2017 scheme transcript (PDF 4–7) is headed “Triail Chluastuisceana Téipscript”; its sections (Fógra 1–2, Comhrá 1–2, Píosa 1–2) are the ones this paper asks about. No other year’s recording is used.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening: “Scríobh síos dhá cháilíocht …” (Fógra a hAon Q2) and “Luaigh dhá chúis …” (Comhrá a hAon, An Chéad Mhír Q1) ask for two points at 2 + 2 ((i) and (ii)); the scheme lists the accepted wording for each. These are answer keys for one task, not task routes.

Card unit for listening: one card per printed segment (Fógra, Mír, Píosa), as the reviewed 2018–2025 components, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion at its published 2 or 2 + 2 tariff (28 questions, 60 marks).
Composition: A–C is a closed choose-one; each of the nine printed titles is its own whole 100-mark card. AISTE nó ALT (form) and the debate stance (ar son nó ina aghaidh) stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 10 (four questions, Q2 at 2 + 2) + Fógra 2 8; Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 (Mír 1 8, Q1 at 2 + 2, + Mír 2 6) + Comhrá 2 14 (Mír 1 8 + Mír 2 6); Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 8 (four questions) + Píosa 2 6), every question 2 marks or 2 + 2; Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C).

Layout: 2017 prints no answer booklet. The cover (PDF 1) carries the instructions; Cuid A is on paper page 2, B on 3–4, C on 5; the composition Treoracha are on page 6 and the choice, length note and titles on page 7; page 8 is blank.

Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3; it is one section-level deduction, stated in each card note without being applied. The listening answer key ends at “Léirigh na marcanna mar seo ar chlúdach na Cluastuisceana:”; 2017 prints no annotation-symbol table.

Composition: 2017 prints no S1–S4 grades and no page of reductions for a short attempt. The Stíl criterion carries the Stíl text only; the off-title pro-rata note is part of the Cumas Gaeilge text on PDF 14. The marking text on PDF 12 is cut before the printed score boxes (“Stíl (5) = …”).

Paper page 7 prints the A, B and C box headings with a SymbolMT dash (U+F02D); it sits only in the raw selection-decision line, never in a card. The A instruction prints “AISTE NÓ ALT” in capitals (2018: “AISTE nó ALT”); the card lifts the paper's own line.
